notes.censoring: 6 GB RSS (RLIMIT_AS on the worker and closure.c mem cap) or 1800 s per job -> censored
notes.closures: M_3, W_3, M_4, W_4 per instance; W_5 where C(N,<=5) <= 40000; both eliminators where libm4ri is present and columns <= 100000; independent eliminator primary above 50000
notes.curves: pick_curve seeds 0, 1, 2 (specification inputs.curves.selection); rule b_upward with count 3 is implemented in run.py as the alternative the brief named
notes.ops_proxy: M4RI: sum over closure iterations of rows x cols; independent: rows x cols
notes.skip_after_consecutive_censored: null = never skip; an integer K would skip the remaining jobs of a (cell, closure, D, eliminator) after K consecutive censored jobs and record them as censored
notes.targets: x(2P) stream (pilot_lib.subgroup_targets) seeded by the trial seed; per (curve, V) the first 150 targets are labelled, the first 30 unique UNSAT and every unique SAT are run
notes.v_rand: per (seed, curve index) subspace seed = first 8 bytes of sha256('V|seed|curve_index'), uniform full-rank k x n F_2 matrix

definitions.censored: job exceeded the per-job RSS cap, the closure memory cap or the per-job wall cap; never a result
definitions.eliminator_agreement: same contains_one; same rank where contains_one is false (both eliminators stop as soon as 1 enters, so the rank at refutation is not canonical)
definitions.evalcheck_mismatch: M4RI: rows not vanishing at a known zero before/after an elimination (-DECH_EVALCHECK); both: basis rows not vanishing at a known solution
definitions.ops_proxy: M4RI: sum over closure iterations of rows x cols; independent eliminator: rows (products inserted) x cols, one iteration
definitions.r_4: UNSAT instances with 1 in W_4 (primary eliminator: independent above 50,000 columns, else M4RI where it ran) / UNSAT instances whose W_4 completed; censored jobs excluded

invalid_reason: codim(W_4) != nsol on a SAT instance
